items.q: I can't sign in. What do I do?
items.a: You probably see "No associated ExamSoft account found." The External ID on your account needs to be corrected. Email Jesse Thompson at [jessetho@hawaii.edu](mailto:jessetho@hawaii.edu). An incognito window will not fix it.

items.q: What font settings should I use?
items.a: Arial 12 for both Question Fonts and Answer Fonts. My Preferences, Question Creation tab.
7 business days before the exam. OME needs the full week to proof the exam on an iPad, print backup copies, and prepare proctor materials.

items.q: What happens if my draft is late?
items.a: A late draft compresses proofing, not the exam date. The proofing steps run in sequence and need the full 7 days.

items.q: Do I have to tag every question?
items.a: Yes. At least one category per question. Untagged questions are invisible to category reporting.
Partial Credit caps how many choices a student can pick. +/- Partial Credit adds points for correct picks and subtracts for wrong ones. Mention it in the stem so students know.

items.q: Can I edit questions after the exam is posted?
items.a: Not once a student has downloaded it. Errors after that point become post-exam scoring adjustments.
OME posts it. Do not post your own exam unless OME has asked you to.

items.q: What should Max Downloads be set to?
Can students open the exam before the proctor gives the password?
items.a: No. The exam stays sealed until the proctor announces the password in the room. The password never goes in an email.
If a student gets locked out of Examplify during an exam (usually from a button combination), they need a resume code to get back in. The proctor has it on the printed materials OME prepares.

items.q: Can I adjust scores on my own?
items.a: Talk to OME first. Accepting a second correct answer or dropping an item changes the record for every student.

items.q: How quickly can I see exam results?
items.a: Within minutes of students uploading their answer files.

items.q: Something looks like an ExamSoft bug. Who do I contact?
items.a: Email Jesse Thompson. OME files all vendor tickets.
The [Legacy Portal section on support.examsoft.com](https://support.examsoft.com/hc/en-us/sections/4730887054093-Legacy-Portal). Start there so you do not land on Enterprise articles.
